name: auto-skill-update-plugin
description: Use when asked to update, extend, or fix a skill definition -- e.g. update the skill to cover X / add this case to skill / the skill missed this case / fix the skill, or any phrasing about correcting a skill. 支持中文触发，如更新这个skill、给skill加上这个情况、skill漏了这个情况等同类表达。Invoke immediately on these signals; the worthiness assessment and confirmation happen inside the skill, not before invoking.
